mapper.select: SELECT id, uuid, material_id AS materialId, material_code AS materialCode, material_name AS materialName, model, brand, category, project_id AS projectId, warehouse_id AS warehouseId, txn_type AS txnType, txn_time AS txnTime, quantity, unit_price AS unitPrice, amount, source_ref_type AS sourceRefType, source_ref_id AS sourceRefId, create_time AS createdAt, create_user AS createdBy, update_time AS updatedAt, update_user AS updatedBy FROM goods_transaction_dynamic_info ORDER BY COALESCE(txn_time, create_time) DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, uuid, material_id AS materialId, material_code AS materialCode, material_name AS materialName, model, brand, category, project_id AS projectId, warehouse_id AS warehouseId, txn_type AS txnType, txn_time AS txnTime, quantity, unit_price AS unitPrice, amount, source_ref_type AS sourceRefType, source_ref_id AS sourceRefId, create_time AS createdAt, create_user AS createdBy, update_time AS updatedAt, update_user AS updatedBy FROM goods_transaction_dynamic_info WHERE uuid = #{uuid}

SELECT id, uuid, material_id AS materialId, material_code AS materialCode, material_name AS materialName, model, brand, category, project_id AS projectId, warehouse_id AS warehouseId, txn_type AS txnType, txn_time AS txnTime, quantity, unit_price AS unitPrice, amount, source_ref_type AS sourceRefType, source_ref_id AS sourceRefId, create_time AS createdAt, create_user AS createdBy, update_time AS updatedAt, update_user AS updatedBy FROM goods_transaction_dynamic_info WHERE source_ref_type = #{sourceRefType} AND source_ref_id = #{sourceRefId} ORDER BY COALESCE(txn_time, create_time) DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO goods_transaction_dynamic_info ( uuid, material_id, material_code, material_name, model, brand, category, project_id, warehouse_id, txn_type, txn_time, quantity, unit_price, amount, source_ref_type, source_ref_id, create_time, create_user ) VALUES ( #{uuid}, #{materialId}, #{materialCode}, #{materialName}, #{model}, #{brand}, #{category}, #{projectId}, #{warehouseId}, #{txnType}, #{txnTime}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{amount}, #{sourceRefType}, #{sourceRefId}, NOW(), #{createdBy} )
